schemaNote: DRAFT research record; S4a fixes the production schema later. No record has been installed.
numericTagging: Numeric arrays inherit the status of their containing block; AO/index counts are DERIVED, solver and checks MEASURED. Geometry is DERIVED from the cited fixture and UNVERIFIED against experiment.

geometry.why: Equal-edge ideal truncated icosahedron from Round 2; both edge kinds are equal, unlike experimental C60. This is a reference feasibility fixture, not experimental geometry.

solver.method: direct RHF; pinned vendored decimals; cart=True; symmetry=True; no density fitting

aoConversion.formula: C_app[i,j] = R[i] * C_pyscf[permutationAppToPySCF[i],j]; chi_pyscf = R * chi_app; S_app = R^-1 S_pyscf R^-1
aoConversion.appOrder: atom, stable l ascending, s; x,y,z; xx,xy,xz,yy,yz,zz
aoConversion.appNormalisation: Each contracted Cartesian component has unit self-overlap (lab/md.js). R=1 for s,p; sqrt(4*pi/5) for axial d, sqrt(4*pi/15) for mixed d. C60 only has s,p.

waterProof.geometrySource: lab/molecules.js H2O, exact app bohr coordinates; water-app.json contains the native solve
waterProof.comparison: All occupied AND virtual coefficient columns, in the same fixed Cartesian frame, up to independent signs; no density-only or subspace-only substitution.

frontier.indexConvention: zero-based MO indices; columns each contain nAO coefficients in app order
frontier.gauge: PySCF eigenbasis within each degenerate set; independent column signs unpinned; S4a canonical gauge pending. Complete degenerate subspaces retained.

validation.scope: CPU AO convention, coefficient orthonormality, Ih character proof. No GPU/render/device verification or RHF stability minimum certification.
